title: Rongorongo and Nazca lines as depictions of plasma discharges

tellings.quote: that when they were in uh Easter Island um his wife Katie they were looking at this what was thought to be a writing called rango rango

plain: The idea here is that rongorongo, a set of carved signs from Easter Island long thought to be a form of writing, and the giant Nazca lines drawn across the desert in Peru may not be writing or art at all, but pictures of huge plasma discharges people once saw in the sky. Matt LaCroix, a guest on the show, passes this on second-hand. He says it came from Robert Schoch and his wife Katie, who were looking at rongorongo on Easter Island, and he credits a work called Forgotten Civilizations. If it were right, these ancient markings would be records of a sky event that ancient people witnessed.
